title: An Introduction To strandCheckR
text: strandCheckR package used window slides across bam file gets count/coverage reads mapping +/- strand window. returned Data Frame gives information across whole genome sliding window. helps quantify amount reads coming double strand genomic DNA. can applied detect DNA contamination within strand specifc RNA-seq assessing whether window contains reads mainly one strand, expected RNA molecules, strands expected contaminating DNA. Hence, considered additional quality checking strand specific RNA data. package can also used detect regions specific behavior (e.g.  highest number reads) whole genome feature regions. window read count function designed flexibly user can filter low mapping quality reads, set read proportion overlap window, set window length & step etc. also implemented efficient way manange big bam file. typical human RNA-seq bam file, takes 3 minutes scan get strand information using standard laptop 2,3 GHz i5 16 GB. function filter reads coming double strand DNA also provided. sliding window, considers proportion +/- stranded reads comparing given threshold, decide window contains reads derived single strand RNA double stranded DNA. read belong window coming RNA removed. read belongs windows coming RNA kept probability caluclated based proportion +/- stranded windows.

title: Calculate strandness information of a bam file
text: package aims check strandedness reads bam file, enabling easy detection contaminating genomic DNA unexpected sources contamination. can applied quantify remove reads correspond putative double strand DNA within strand-specific RNA sample. package uses sliding window scan bam file find number positive/negative reads window. provides method plot proportions positive/negative stranded alignments within windows, allow users determine much sample contaminated, determine appropriate threshold filtering. Finally, users can filter putative DNA contamination strand-specific RNAseq sample using selected threshold.
